file_review.CMakeLists.txt: Generated storage bindings resolve the ProcessScope import. The launcher and witness build under sanitizers and -Werror.
file_review.proto/spatial/workspace/v1/storage.proto: Additive private launch/control schemas. Existing production storage message fields remain unchanged.
file_review.src/workspace/resources.cpp: Pinned cgroup descriptors retain accounting identity. Funded usage is clamped per reservation. Unfunded charges and unchanged kernel hard limits remain enforced.
file_review.src/workspace/storage_channel.hpp: Optional borrowed pidfd preserves existing callers and adds retained-handle ownership.
file_review.src/workspace/storage_channel.cpp: Duplicates and validates the transferred live pidfd with the expected peer PID. Existing Unix sender credential checks remain active.
file_review.src/workspace/storage_main.cpp: Validates paired descriptor arguments and protected policy. Runtime broker UID and retained pidfd must match before storage service creation.
file_review.src/supervisor/storage_launch.hpp: One retained launcher owns one private service and exposes checked stop and liveness.
file_review.src/supervisor/storage_launch.cpp: Canonical protected inputs, private Unix credentials, explicit argv/environment, finite control waits, fixed executable, bounded root service, and exact-unit cleanup. Negative-path qualification remains pending.
file_review.src/testing/storage_launch_probe.cpp: Thin protobuf lifecycle witness calls the production launcher. Its policy is a trusted private fixture, not an actor interface.
file_review.tools/bootstrap_storage.py: Reviewed operator-only installer. Root atomic replacement records the source digest and preserves an explicitly approved prior executable. Both actual first installations are witnessed.
file_review.tests/native/test_storage_git_integratio: Existing five behavior assertions remain. Production-owner mode adds live service identity/resource witnesses and checked owner teardown. No locked test changed.
